flags.kv_pool_note: --max-total-tokens can only LOWER the profiled pool; the actual size is in flags.resolved.max_total_num_tokens when the log reports it

sharing.definition: block_sharing_rate = leading block-aligned prefix blocks already present in an earlier request / total block-aligned prompt blocks. This is the infinite-cache ORACLE hit rate and an upper bound on any measured one.

notes: OPEN LOOP: precomputed Poisson schedule (bench/loadgen.py discipline); latency is timed from INTENDED dispatch, so harness lateness is included, and a run whose dispatch drift exceeds the threshold is invalid.

slo.source: results/p2/RESULTS.md (job 11608159, H200; TTFT p50 43.4ms x10, TPOT p50 9.3ms x3)

reasons: not_steady_state: Steady state NOT verified: In-flight count TRENDS across the window: this is not steady state. Either the run is above the knee (where steady state cannot exist) or the window is too short. Percentiles from it describe a ramp. Numbers from this window are labeled 'unsaturated-window measurement'.

stationarity.label: unsaturated-window measurement
stationarity.note: In-flight count TRENDS across the window: this is not steady state. Either the run is above the knee (where steady state cannot exist) or the window is too short. Percentiles from it describe a ramp.

dispatch_drift.p99_note: n=935: p99 is interpolated near the top of the sample and carries roughly one sample of resolution (R15).

definitions.preemptions: delta sglang:num_retracted_requests_total; absent series on a live endpoint (sglang:num_running_reqs present) = 0 (labeled counter, exported after first increment)
definitions.evictions: delta sglang:evicted_tokens_total (TOKENS, not blocks); absent series on a live endpoint = 0, as for preemptions
definitions.prefix_hit_rate: delta sglang:prefill_effective_tokens_total with mode in ['device_hit', 'host_hit', 'storage_hit'] / delta sglang:prefill_effective_tokens_total over all modes (TOKEN granularity). sglang:cache_hit_rate is NOT used: it covers the last prefill batch only

anomalies.detail: tpot_ms: 2 KDE modes near 1.8, 22.6; valley at 3.8 holds 0.00x the smaller peak; 95% of mass below it; Sarle BC 0.896 (n=699)
ttft_ms: median of first 69 steady requests 4020.0 vs 14856.0 for the remaining 630 (0.27x); the steady window still contains a ramp
tpot_ms: 31/699 samples > 5x the median (1.8); max 35.0 at positions [55, 78, 134, 147, 157, 170, 181, 192, 203, 256] in send order. p99 may be set by these alone.
